measurements.note: The second figure prints as '521', with no space -- read as 52 feet, the trailing '1' being OCR of the foot mark, as the '60' and the '22' x 35' beside it are printed. A reading, marked as one. An earlier version of this record printed the quote as '52 1'; three separate reads of the data page (two extractions and a search snippet) return '521' and the space was removed.

note: This survey is a one-page Architectural Data Form and not the usual Part I/Part II outline, so its quotes carry the form's printed field labels: everything the surveyor wrote about this building fits on one sheet. Two things worth carrying against the node: the form's own style line is 'Stick Style/Shingle Style' rather than Stick Style flat, and it records 'gable, mansard and hip roofs' on one house, which no single `roof_pitch` figure can describe. Written 5 Sep 2026 (WP-11.3, Queen Anne and Stick Style cluster).
